verified.summary: The scope is sound. feat/br-2026-10-04-p0-queue/phase-3 resolves to 42ae15b, which is also the worktree HEAD, and the three-dot diff lists 55 files. All five findings hold up against the tree, but none is CRITICAL or HIGH and nothing here freezes at merge. Findings 2 and 5 describe the same gap and are merged below. That leaves four survivors: one MEDIUM product issue (the pill's 30px tap target, an outlier in a codebase that wraps every 30px chip in a 44px hit area and still waiting on a design call) and three LOWs. Two LOWs are test gaps: the leverage tests never check that Set clears the pill, and no test runs the Settings reset inside the real app. The third LOW is the hardcoded scrim colour. I demoted the leverage test gap from MEDIUM to LOW: the product code is correct today, and the surviving mutant is worked out on paper rather than run. Every claimed-correct item I spot-checked held. All survivors can be fixed after merge.

confirmed.title: The pill's tap target is 30px tall, below VistaSize.tapTarget (44), and the codebase's own pattern gives every 30px chip a 44px hit area
confirmed.failurePath: On any route, at any viewport or text scale, the GestureDetector sits inside Positioned(height: SimulationIndicator.slot = 30). Its Align(widthFactor: 1) fills the 30px strip, so the hit region is the pill's width by 30px (93.5-266.5 x 610-640 at 360x640, per cta_probe.log). Outside Settings, the pill is the only way to reach the note and its Reset demo. This is the iter-1 M4, still open and waiting on a design call.
confirmed.fix: Keep the 30px strip, but let the hit area reach above it with a transparent pad to about 44px, the same way the existing chips do. Re-check that it stays clear of VistaBottomNav and of the sheets' bottom buttons. Or raise the slot to VistaSize.tapTarget. That is a design decision that costs every screen 14px.
confirmed.why: I read simulation_indicator.dart:38-41 and 81-117, and vista_metrics.dart:27 (tapTarget = 44). I checked the reviewer's claim that every other control meets 44px. The existing 30px and 28px chips (order_ticket.dart:584-588 'Cross · Nx', :622 _chip, open_order_card.dart:194-198) all wrap a 30px visual in SizedBox(height: 44 / VistaSize.tapTarget). The pill is the only control that does not. The iter-1 review baton records that iOSTapTargetGuideline fails at 138.9x30.

confirmed.title: The 1.3x leverage tests check that Set can be tapped, not that Set clears the pill. A dropped-inset mutant leaves Set 6px under the pill at both phone sizes and passes all four tests.
confirmed.failurePath: The mutant changes `EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 10, 16, 24 + safe)` to `... 24)` in the shared _LeverageSheet (feed_order_ticket.dart is `part of` order_ticket.dart). The phones map gives a bottom padding of 0, so safe is 30 (just the strip). resetDemo restores everything the phase-1 reset did, because it calls the same Scenario.reset() (scenario.dart:220-236) and SettingsState.reset(). Scenario.reset() covers cash, positions, open orders, hasMarket/ticker/marketId (the listing), liked, favoriteAssets/Traders, followers/following/followed, clock, receipts and stalePrices. SettingsState.reset() also resets DisplayPrefs. Nothing that phase 1 restored was dropped.

Pop to root from any depth. The only Navigator is the root one (grep finds no nested Navigator and no useRootNavigator). Every sheet (showModalBottomSheet) and every pushed screen (MaterialPageRoute/CupertinoPageRoute) is on it, and the note runs on the same navigator through `navigatorKey`. So popUntil(isFirst) from either the note context or the Settings context closes the note, any order ticket or its leverage sheet, Settings, and nested market/profile routes. Local ticket state (leverage, amount, the minted action id) is disposed with its route. The leverage awaits guard with `mounted` (order_ticket.dart:582, feed_order_ticket.dart:165). A popped ticket cannot re-confirm a stale action id after the reset clears receipts.

The toast tells the truth. ScaffoldMessenger is captured before the pop, and the 'Demo reset to fixture-v1' SnackBar is shown only after Scenario.reset() and SettingsState.reset() have run. Both are plain synchronous assignments that cannot fail. MaterialApp places its ScaffoldMessenger above the builder, so the pill's note context resolves it.

A double reset is idempotent: unit test 'reset twice yields equal state'. Each reset calls hideCurrentSnackBar before showSnackBar, so a second reset replaces the first toast instead of stacking two. Every one of the 17 showSnackBar call sites in lib hides the current one first, so no stale 'Undo' snackbar can queue behind the reset toast. A quick second tap on the closing note or Settings is ignored while the route animates out. The `_open` flag stops the pill, which sits above the scrim, from opening a second note.

Root-route tabs keep no stale copies of Scenario. No initState in app_shell/home/markets/arena/portfolio/watchlist reads Scenario values into fields. They all read through listeners or getters, so the root screen redraws from the restored store. AppShell.tab is left as it is, which matches the phase-1 behaviour.

The copy is true. The pill reads 'Simulated · ' + Scenario.fixtureVersion ('fixture-v1'). The note is the spec sentence word for word: 'All prices, fills, balances and results are simulated. Nothing leaves this device.' lib has no http, url_launcher or Share calls. The only outward side effects are Clipboard writes on the device. pubspec dependencies are flutter and flutter_svg only. Nothing claims results are live.

LiveFeed drift (carried from phase 1, not new). MarketPrices.of uses a constant base, so `_bases[key] == base` always holds and a reset never re-bases price feeds. The 'portfolio' feed re-bases only if the cash figure changed. So after any reset, from the pill or from Settings, prices and an untraded balance keep their drifted values. This diff does not change that mechanism. It makes reset reachable from every screen, and both entry points now land on the root tabs where drifting figures show. That is slightly more visible, but it is the same defect, and resetDemo is the one place to fix it. The fix is out of scope for this unit, as stated.
